list.name: serial
list.label: Device
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT serial_number FROM devices ORDER BY serial_number

targets.rawSql: SELECT serial_number AS "Serial", hub_id AS "Hub ID", last_seen_at AS "Last Seen", first_seen_at AS "First Seen" FROM devices ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT cs.time AS "time", cs.watts * CASE WHEN COALESCE(cc.invert_display, false) THEN -1 ELSE 1 END * CASE WHEN COALESCE(cc.is_240v_single_clamp, false) THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS "value", COALESCE(cc.label, concat('G', cs.group_idx, ' C', cs.circuit_idx)) AS metric FROM circuit_samples cs LEFT JOIN circuit_config cc ON cc.serial_number = cs.serial_number AND cc.group_idx = cs.group_idx AND cc.circuit_idx = cs.circuit_idx WHERE cs.serial_number = '$serial' AND $__timeFilter(cs.time) ORDER BY cs.time
SELECT time AS "time", true_power_kw AS "value", concat('Group ', group_idx) AS metric FROM group_samples WHERE serial_number = '$serial' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time
SELECT time AS "time", voltage AS "value", concat('Group ', group_idx) AS metric FROM group_samples WHERE serial_number = '$serial' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time
SELECT time AS "time", frequency AS "value", concat('Group ', group_idx) AS metric FROM group_samples WHERE serial_number = '$serial' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

SELECT cs.time AS "time", cs.power_factor AS "value", COALESCE(cc.label, concat('G', cs.group_idx, ' C', cs.circuit_idx)) AS metric FROM circuit_samples cs LEFT JOIN circuit_config cc ON cc.serial_number = cs.serial_number AND cc.group_idx = cs.group_idx AND cc.circuit_idx = cs.circuit_idx WHERE cs.serial_number = '$serial' AND $__timeFilter(cs.time) ORDER BY cs.time
